reason: User requests all A before B, unattended automatic chaining, max25 epochs with patience5/min_delta0.0001. Registered while A_tiny E1 is in progress, before any completed epoch metrics.

training.improvement_rule: current AP-only Macro-AUC > reference AP-only Macro-AUC + 0.0001; otherwise increment consecutive bad_epochs; reset on significant improvement
training.checkpoint_selection: highest observed AP-only Macro-AUC EMA best.pt; ties prefer earlier epoch
training.LR_schedule: one warmup epoch then cosine over max25 budget; current E1 is scheduler-identical to old max2 run because all E1 updates are warmup
training.early_stop_baseline: first completed epoch AP-only score, no E0 comparison

migration.new_monitor_initialization: compute actual E1 AP-only score without training after original process exits; initialize AP best/ref from that score
migration.resume_claim: explicit policy migration; E1 optimizer/RNG preserved; LR schedule changes only after warmup, not an exact continuation of old2-epoch experiment

validation.ap_only: all view_position values in Study equal AP
validation.primary: fixed Tiny/Base fusion AP-only Macro-AUC B minus A
validation.sampling_unit: patient with all Studies; probabilities mean within Study only
validation.selection_bias: AP-only is used for stopping/model selection. Report exploratory valid metrics and conditional patient CIs, not independent generalization or proof of online gains.

orchestration.original_stop: write STOP during existing E1; wait full validation/checkpoint and process exit
orchestration.start_B_only_after: A_tiny and A_base both complete or early-stopped with validated best checkpoints
